scope: Workflow coverage, not certification or automatic runtime activation. Select supporting skills only for affected boundaries.

capabilities.title: Frontend Engineering
capabilities.deliverable: A working user journey with explicit loading, empty, error and durable-success states.
capabilities.failure_probe: Reverse response order and repeat a mutation; older intent must not win and durable effects must not duplicate.
capabilities.prerequisites: Actual framework runtime and browser; backend boundary for durable effects.

capabilities.title: Backend Engineering
capabilities.deliverable: A versioned service contract exercised through authorization, persistence and failure recovery.
capabilities.failure_probe: Replay an idempotency key with another payload and simulate commit-before-timeout.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target language/framework, isolated datastore and controlled dependency.

capabilities.title: Brand Guidelining
capabilities.deliverable: An editable brand guide with semantic tokens, voice examples, asset rules and real specimens.
capabilities.failure_probe: Apply the rules to a dense screen and a small/dark asset; expose conflicting tokens or illegible marks.
capabilities.prerequisites: Approved brand inputs or explicitly proposed direction; renderer and font/asset rights.

capabilities.title: Web Design
capabilities.deliverable: Rendered pages with purposeful composition, real content, responsive states and working interactions.
capabilities.failure_probe: Use long real labels and narrow width; the primary action and content hierarchy remain usable.
capabilities.prerequisites: Local app/browser; supplied, existing or explicitly proposed design direction and content.

capabilities.title: Mobile Design
capabilities.deliverable: Platform-specific navigation, touch/input, accessibility and state recovery verified in context.
capabilities.failure_probe: Open the keyboard, enlarge text and return via back navigation without losing entered state.
capabilities.prerequisites: Named native/web platform; simulator for native build/layout; physical hardware for touch, keyboard and gesture claims.

capabilities.title: SEO Expertise
capabilities.deliverable: URL-level crawl/index/content findings tied to observations and an ordered remediation plan.
capabilities.failure_probe: A robots-allowed but noindex page must not be reported indexable; inaccessible Search Console stays unknown.
capabilities.prerequisites: Authorized public URLs; current search-provider docs; dashboards only when available.

capabilities.title: Deep Researches
capabilities.deliverable: A source-linked synthesis with claim-level support, counterevidence, applicability and unresolved uncertainty.
capabilities.failure_probe: Introduce conflicting versions and a syndicated copy; neither stale claims nor duplicates become independent support.
capabilities.prerequisites: Search/retrieval tools and primary sources; access limitations recorded.

capabilities.title: Interface QA Engineering
capabilities.deliverable: A defect report from exercised roles/states with reproducible triggers, expected results and exact visual evidence.
capabilities.failure_probe: Break keyboard focus return and inject a stale response; catch behavior defects despite a good screenshot.
capabilities.prerequisites: Real browser and app; a11y tools/screen reader where required.

capabilities.title: Illustration
capabilities.deliverable: A coherent original illustration composed for its placement with editable geometry or the requested raster source.
capabilities.failure_probe: Review the actual artifact against the complete brief at use size and in focal detail; attractive materials cannot excuse malformed contact or incorrect construction. A raster wrapped in SVG fails editable-vector requirements.
capabilities.prerequisites: Select the production lead by medium before registration: available native image generation/editing for bitmap art; svg-creation for native vector requirements. Confirm runtime and preserve requested editability, animation and format.

capabilities.title: Crafting Visual Assets
capabilities.deliverable: A consistent asset family with master sources, export sizes, naming and integration contracts.
capabilities.failure_probe: Inspect the asset family at intended sizes and backgrounds for lost detail, inconsistent construction or crops; for SVG, also place two inline instances to expose ID collisions.
capabilities.prerequisites: Confirm asset rights and target consumer. Select the production lead by medium before registration: available native image generation/editing for bitmap art; svg-creation for native vector requirements. Confirm runtime and preserve requested editability, animation and format.

capabilities.title: Animation
capabilities.deliverable: Motion that communicates actual state, handles interruption and preserves reduced-motion functionality.
capabilities.failure_probe: Reverse or cancel midway, unmount and change motion preference; no stale state or trapped control.
capabilities.prerequisites: Actual UI engine/browser; native platform or video renderer for those distinct deliverables.

capabilities.title: Project Review
capabilities.deliverable: Prioritized findings with concrete triggers, affected consumers, consequences and a scoped repair plan.
capabilities.failure_probe: Seed a plausible cross-boundary defect; the review must trace it rather than list generic best practices.
capabilities.prerequisites: Repository/history, runnable relevant checks and stated review boundary.

capabilities.title: Planning
capabilities.deliverable: An executable sequence with dependencies, decisions, ownership, acceptance evidence and resume state.
capabilities.failure_probe: Change a blocking assumption halfway; dependent work and the durable plan must reconcile.
capabilities.prerequisites: Authoritative brief and current project state; no extra runtime required.

capabilities.title: Product Management
capabilities.deliverable: A defensible product decision, bounded delivery slice, guardrails and measurement contract.
capabilities.failure_probe: A loud customer request with no population baseline must not become invented universal demand.
capabilities.prerequisites: Actual customer/product evidence and decision owner.

capabilities.title: Database Expert
capabilities.deliverable: Correct constraints, representative query plans and migration/recovery evidence on the named engine.
capabilities.failure_probe: Interrupt a batch and resume under old/new writers; preserve every row and invariant.
capabilities.prerequisites: Named database engine/version, representative isolated data and recovery path.

capabilities.title: System Engineering
capabilities.deliverable: A coherent system model, capacity/failure analysis, contracts and a verifiable operational design.
capabilities.failure_probe: Fail a dependency or exhaust a bounded queue; identify propagation, backpressure and recovery.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target topology, workload/limits, telemetry and an isolated failure experiment.

capabilities.title: Devops and Infrastructure Engineering
capabilities.deliverable: Reviewed infrastructure plan and reproducible build/release/recovery evidence for an exact target.
capabilities.failure_probe: Present stale plan, secret-bearing output or mixed-version rollback; detect invalid assumptions before changes.
capabilities.prerequisites: Existing IaC/build/runtime tools and explicit target access; production mutation requires task authorization.

capabilities.title: Marketing Expert
capabilities.deliverable: Audience-specific positioning/copy with traceable claims and channel fit; a measurable experiment when the task requires one.
capabilities.failure_probe: Remove the claimed proof or change offer conditions; revised copy must retain truth and qualifications.
capabilities.prerequisites: Approved offer, customer evidence and channel context; publication/spend separately authorized.

capabilities.title: CEO perspective
capabilities.deliverable: A strategic choice connecting customer value, economics, capacity, cash timing and reversibility.
capabilities.failure_probe: Stress adoption, margin or capacity assumptions; show when the recommendation changes and who decides.
capabilities.prerequisites: Actual business facts; explicit hypothetical labels for absent financial/market evidence.

capabilities.title: Data Analysis and Deep Understanding
capabilities.deliverable: Reproducible reconciled analysis with grain, units, population, missingness, alternatives and a supported decision.
capabilities.failure_probe: Duplicate joined rows and shift segment mix; totals reconcile and aggregate uplift is not mistaken for causality.
capabilities.prerequisites: Authorized data and query/script/workbook runtime; source meaning beyond column names.

capabilities.title: Project Scafolding
capabilities.deliverable: A minimal runnable project or vertical slice with verified startup, tests, config and ownership.
capabilities.failure_probe: Scaffold into a nonempty repository with existing conventions; preserve all unrelated files and detect conflicts.
capabilities.prerequisites: Chosen stack and available generator/toolchain; no automatic dependency install or unrelated framework.

capabilities.title: Design Revisioning
capabilities.deliverable: An attributable revision preserving approved constraints, working behavior and comparable before/after views.
capabilities.failure_probe: A polish request must not silently change labels, brand identity or data behavior; compare identical states.
capabilities.prerequisites: Baseline source/renders, requested revision scope and existing tokens/components.

capabilities.title: Efficiency and Optimization Expert
capabilities.deliverable: A measured bottleneck fix with correctness parity, representative workload and repeatable before/after measurements.
capabilities.failure_probe: A faster run with changed inputs, warm cache or weaker correctness must not count as an improvement.
capabilities.prerequisites: Target profiler/load/query tools, comparable runtime and data; cost limits where relevant.
